verdict.rationale: Marqeta is an API platform, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair ask. However, every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and no documentation item mentions a downloadable spec. The docs offer only markdown reference pages and in-browser interactive widgets, which are not a machine-readable API spec. Confidence is medium because the probes covered only common paths, and a spec could exist at a nonstandard location.
